notes: Normal release on aa1ca3d plus sender-ack-pack-experiment.patch. Consecutive already-eligible ACK snapshots for one session/tag share a physical datagram, capped at four records and the baseline payload. Each consumed snapshot uses the existing 64-job work budget.

Control remains 4 MiB/s with a 16-physical-datagram burst. No waiting, queue search, buffer increase, controller or MTU change. Physical history/control charging is once per packet; each record retains its own final delay.
339 ordinary release tests and 65 short kernel/integration tests, Clippy and fmt passed. Full routed PMTU was not rerun for this experiment.
Not adopted: no clear overall gain relative to retained suffix; reverse unlimited goodput declines 5.2% from 21G. No diagnostic instrumented packet-packing fraction was collected.
Four 20-second retained-daemon points; no builds or other tests overlap load.

Directions L->R/R->L, endpoint arrays L/R; goodput excludes drain, missing ratios include drain. 100% CPU equals one core. TAP SKB drops, frame expiry and queue entries cannot be summed into exact frame loss.
No 20 Gbit/s local gate, real-path gate or CPU ceiling is established.
